change: Precise preview positioning, cue playback and shared transport shortcuts
notes: Preview windows and build/test processes were stopped during this run. DSP and benchmark sources are unchanged; Cargo reused the existing benchmark binary, which does not link the viewer.

Criterion reports a historical baseline improvement of -3.45% and telemetry regression of +6.88%. Telemetry includes four high-severe outliers and a wide confidence interval. This does not establish causation by the UI/control-thread changes.
Four channels; playback restarts every 180 blocks. Telemetry queues are consumed every 12 blocks, approximately 30 Hz.
This microbenchmark excludes GPUI input/layout/painting, plugin windows, transport command latency and device I/O. It does not measure UI frame rate, callback p95/p99 or xrun endurance.

Separate transport smoke uses GPUI keyboard dispatch and pointer controllers with measured bounds, the real engine and simulated output. It verifies cue/loop/Go/multiwindow controls and an unchanged authoring snapshot; it does not validate physical mouse hit testing or device playback.
